financing.summary: DSLD Homes is a private builder run by its managing partners (CEO Saun Sullivan, CFO Jeff Purpera, Lee Foster) that publishes no financial statements, so its lenders, debt and lot counts are not public. What is on the record is how it gets land: it buys finished lots a filing at a time (roughly 26 to 110 lots per deed, about $60,000 a lot in the Baton Rouge region) from local third-party developers and from development entities its own partners sign for, so developers and partner affiliates carry the land that a land banker would otherwise carry. Its CFO said in November 2025 that 'bankers and bondholders' ask how big it plans to get, which indicates bank debt and some form of bonds, with no terms disclosed. No institutional land banker or lot-option financier is named anywhere, and no link to Domain, Millrose, Kennedy Lewis or TPG Angelo Gordon was found. Room for a land banker looks real but relationship-driven: the company crossed $1B of revenue, is spreading into Tennessee and Houston where it lacks its home-market developer network, and its principals already run their own lot-holding vehicle (Pavo Capital).
financing.land_strategy: Finished-lot buyer, in effect land-light without calling itself that. It takes lots down by subdivision filing from local developers on a steady 'even flow' build schedule, and sources part of its supply from land entities tied to its own partners (Livingston Parc LLC, Noco LLC). In 2018 the partners said they bought about 250 lots a month; no current figure or stated owned-versus-optioned target is published.

lots.source_title: DSLD Homes: About Us (page as of 2026-11-18)
lots.note: No lot counts are published. Scale markers only: more than 120 active communities across LA, MS, AL, TN, TX and northwest FL (company site, Nov 2026); 4,116 closings and $1.1B revenue in 2024 (Builder magazine list as reported by Business Report, 2025-07-09). Recorded lot purchases reported by Business Report in three Baton Rouge-area parishes from Dec 2024 to Nov 2026 total about 685 lots for about $41.5M (about $60,000 per finished lot); Louisiana is about 65% of closings, so this is a small sample of company-wide buying.

land_banking.description: Third-party developer of the roughly 800-lot Atwater project in south Baton Rouge. DSLD takes down finished lots in its Atwater Villas community in phases: 149 lots for $10.7M (Feb 2024), 51 lots for $3.8M (Sep 2025), 26 lots for $2.0M (Mar 2026) and 27 lots for $2.1M (Jun 2026). The developer carries the land between takedowns, so it plays the role a land banker would.
land_banking.source_title: Business Report: DSLD just purchased more than two dozen lots in this Baton Rouge subdivision (2026-06-04)
land_banking.note: Lots and dollars are the sum of four reported tranches. A 2026-09-01 Business Report roundup lists another 26 lots for $2M from Atwater Development; it may be a fifth tranche or a repeat of the March deed, so it is not counted. The free excerpt of the Sep 2025 story does not show the seller's name. Other tranche sources: businessreport.com/dsld-just-bought-these-subdivision-lots-for-10m/ ; /these-homebuilders-have-purchased-lots-in-the-atwater-development/ ; /whos-building-and-whos-buying-in-greater-baton-rouge-28/ ; /whos-building-and-whos-buying-in-greater-baton-rouge-50/. Atwater signs through Todd Waguespack (Level Homes founder).

land_banking.description: Local developer (president William Fakouri) that sells DSLD finished lots by filing: 50 lots in Eden Way, Denham Springs, for $2.7M (Mar 2025) and 37 lots in Belle Arbor on Hooper Road near Central for $2.5M (Nov 2026).
land_banking.source_title: Business Report: DSLD buys 37 lots as local housing market shows signs of resilience (2026-11-13)

land_banking.description: Seller of lots to DSLD in a Denham Springs / Livingston Parish community: 71 lots for $3.4M (Apr 2025) and 83 lots for $4.6M (Nov 2025). DSLD partner and CFO Jeffery Purpera signed for both buyer and seller, which points to a land-development entity controlled by DSLD's own partners.
land_banking.source_title: Business Report: DSLD acquires 83 more lots in Denham Springs development (2025-11-06)
land_banking.note: Affiliate status is inferred from Purpera representing both parties; the ownership of Livingston Parc LLC was not checked in state filings. April 2025 tranche: businessreport.com/dsld-purchases-more-lots-for-livingston-parish-expansion/.

land_banking.description: Sold DSLD 54 lots for the fourth filing of Hunter's Ridge in Livingston Parish for $2.7M. Jeffery Purpera of DSLD represented both the buyer and the seller, the same pattern as Livingston Parc LLC.
land_banking.source_title: Business Report: Who's building and who's buying in Greater Baton Rouge (2026-05-26)
land_banking.note: Light check 2026-11-19: the cited roundup (free preview) and the Business Report site search did not show the Noco LLC / Hunter's Ridge item, so the lots, price and common signer could not be confirmed; downgraded from Reported. Affiliate status is inferred from the common signer; ownership of Noco LLC not checked in state filings.

land_banking.description: Baton Rouge holding company whose directors, per Louisiana Secretary of State filings cited by Business Report, are DSLD partners Jeffery Purpera and Lee Foster. In April to July 2025 it bought 157 finished lots for about $13.4M in communities built by other builders: 33 in Highlandia ($1.8M), 31 in Atwater Reserve ($2.6M), 23 in Water's Edge ($2.3M) and 70 in Level Homes' Delaune Estates ($6.7M). The Highlandia seller said Pavo plans to sell the lots on to Level Homes and AP Dodson.
land_banking.source_title: Business Report: Local holding company acquires 70 lots in Ascension development (2025-07-29)
land_banking.note: This looks like a private lot bank run by DSLD's principals for other local builders, not for DSLD Homes: Business Report corrected its Highlandia story to say DSLD Homes did not buy those lots. The 'lot bank' reading is an inference from the resale plan. Other sources: businessreport.com/this-company-just-bought-over-30-lots-in-the-highlandia-community/ ; /this-company-bought-31-lots-in-the-atwater-development/ ; /local-holding-company-acquires-over-20-lots-in-waters-edge-community/.

land_banking.description: Developer of the Conway mixed-use project in Gonzales (about 929 single-family lots planned). DSLD Homes LLC bought 108 lots in phase three of the Reserve at Conway for $6.2M; a 159-lot phase four is planned.
land_banking.source_title: Business Report: A homebuilder purchased more than 100 lots to expand this neighborhood (2025-01-10)
land_banking.note: Ryan Power signed for the developer, Jeffery Purpera for DSLD.

land_banking.description: Covington-based seller of 61 lots on a 23-acre tract to DSLD for $4.7M for the new Cypress Garden subdivision in Gonzales, DSLD's sixth Ascension Parish community.
land_banking.source_title: Business Report: DSLD purchases lots for its sixth Ascension Parish residential development (2025-03-26)
land_banking.note: Light check 2026-11-19: removed 'managed by developer Jeffery Vallee' from the description because the cited article's free excerpt does not name H12's manager; unconfirmed.

land_banking.description: Sold DSLD 91 lots (second and third filings) in Dogwood Trace, Walker, for $4.8M. The same company later sold 70 Delaune Estates lots to Pavo Capital.
land_banking.source_title: Business Report: This Livingston Parish community is about to get 90-plus new homes (2024-12-27)
land_banking.note: Brandon Dodson signed for the seller; Brian Cohn signed for DSLD.

land_banking.description: Sold DSLD Homes LLC 79 lots (sixth and seventh filings) in Fairview Gardens, Zachary, for $4.7M.
land_banking.source_title: Business Report: DSLD purchases dozens of lots in this Zachary community (2024-11-20)
land_banking.note: Timothy Henning signed for the seller, Jeffery Purpera Jr. for DSLD.

land_banking.description: DSLD entered Houston in 2023 as a lot buyer in Emberly, a master-planned community developed by Starwood Land. Shows that in new markets DSLD buys lots from institutional master-plan developers instead of developing land itself.
land_banking.source_title: DSLD Homes blog: We're expanding into Houston Market! (2023-07-03)
land_banking.note: Stale: Emberly is no longer on DSLD's community list (the page returned 'not found' on 2026-11-19); current Houston-area pages are Mostyn Springs, Aldeana and Two Step Farm, whose developers were not checked.

land_banking.description: Chicago single-family-rental investor that buys newly built DSLD homes in bulk. Not land banking and not a land banker: a home buyer, listed here as a capital relationship. About 60 properties in the Corinne Place subdivision in Lafayette for about $12M by Nov 2023 (the latest 10 bought from DSLD for just under $2.1M); then 7 homes in three DSLD communities for $1.49M (Nov 2024), 7 in three Denham Springs communities for $1.5M (Dec 2024) and 8 (Arbor Walk and Manor Pointe) from DSLD Homes LLC for $1.7M (reported 2025-01-02).
land_banking.source_title: Business Report: This home rental company continues its expansion in the Capital Region (2025-01-02)
land_banking.note: Buying entities: SFR KL MS Borrower I LLC and CF KL Assets 2019-3 LLC. Lafayette detail: theadvocate.com/acadiana/news/business/a-chicago-group-paid-12m-for-a-lafayette-subdivision/article_d03df25c-7fe2-11ee-a8f2-6f1d631ad97b.html (2023-11-10). No forward purchase agreement is reported. Light check 2026-11-19: the $1.49M tranche was dated Oct 2024; corrected to Nov 2024 per the cited article (dated 2025-01-02: 'in November' for $1.49M and 'last month' for $1.5M).

debt.instrument: Bank debt and bonds, terms undisclosed (CFO refers to 'bankers and bondholders')
debt.source_title: Business Report: The road to $1 billion (2025-11-21)
debt.note: Derived from one quote by CFO Jeff Purpera that bankers and bondholders want to know how big the company plans to get. No lender, agent bank, bond series, amount, coupon or maturity is public. 'Bondholders' most likely means privately placed notes; it could also be loose usage. SEC EDGAR has no filer named DSLD, so nothing is registered.

joint_ventures.partner: Stoa Holdings LLC (Toby Easterly, Ryan Nash)
joint_ventures.description: CEO Saun Sullivan is a listed officer of Stoa Holdings LLC alongside Toby Easterly and Ryan Nash. Its entity Bauerle Rd Land LLC bought a 20-acre tract in the Village at Conway (Gonzales) for $5M in May 2025. This is a principal-level investment, not a DSLD Homes joint venture; DSLD separately buys lots in the Reserve at Conway.
joint_ventures.source_title: Business Report: Tract within Conway Development in Ascension sells for $5M (2025-05-29)
joint_ventures.note: Planned use of the tract is not stated in the article. No homebuilding joint venture of DSLD Homes itself was found.

Ownership of Livingston Parc LLC, Noco LLC and Core Development and Construction: not confirmed in state filings; affiliate reading rests on DSLD's CFO or its signer acting for both sides
